Prerequisites for graphics switching and hibernation

Switching GPUs may interrupt the graphical session. Save your work first and make sure you have a working TTY or recovery entry point. The modes offered by GPU management tools depend on hardware and firmware; do not apply them based on brand alone.

Configuring hibernation involves more than adding a hook: it also requires a swap target, an initramfs resume mechanism, and a usable resume location. Modern UEFI + systemd environments can use HibernateLocation to record the location automatically. When configuring a swapfile manually, specify the device containing the file and resume_offset. Add only parameters confirmed necessary through troubleshooting to GRUB_CMDLINE_LINUX_DEFAULT. nowatchdog and watchdog driver blacklists disable the relevant fault detection and should not be added by default; confirm module names against the actual hardware. pcie_aspm=force may cause lockups or data risks on incompatible devices and is not a general-purpose power-saving parameter. Experiment only after identifying a specific problem, confirming support, and preparing a rollback.

There are three performance profiles: performance, balanced, and power-saver. Tools such as power-profiles-daemon and TLP each have their own suitable use cases; avoid enabling conflicting managers at the same time.
